scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm -w apps/server run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w apps/server run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.demo: npm run demo:seed && cross-env MATCH_THRESHOLD=0.1 npm run dev
